units.source_text: 此后末摘花在这旧邸里住了两年，然后迁居二条院的东院。

en.t: After this, Suetsumuhana lived in the old mansion for two years, and then moved to the eastern residence of Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 源氏公子虽然极少与她聚谈，但因近在咫尺，故出入之便，亦常探望一下，待她并不简慢。

en.t: Although Lord Genji rarely sat and talked with her, she was close by, so it was convenient for him to come and go, and he often looked in on her; he did not treat her carelessly.

units.source_text: 她的姨母大弍夫人返京，闻知此事，大为吃惊。

en.t: When her aunt, the wife of the Daini, returned to the capital and heard about this, she was greatly astonished.

units.source_text: 侍从庆幸小姐得宠，又悔不当时耐性等待，自愧眼光短浅可耻。

en.t: The gentlewoman Jijū rejoiced that her young lady had gained favor, but also regretted not having waited patiently at the time, and felt ashamed of her own shortsightedness.

units.source_text: ——凡此种种，笔者本当不问自告，但因今日头痛，心绪烦恼，懒于执笔。

en.t: All these matters are things the writer ought to tell without being asked, but today my head aches, my mind is troubled, and I am reluctant to take up the brush.

units.source_text: 且待将来另有机会，再行追忆详情，奉告列位看官。

en.t: Let me wait until another opportunity comes in the future, when I will recall the details again and report them to you, my readers.
